entities.summary: Demak, a notable figure in the history of Indonesia, associated with Islamic Sultanates Era (1500–1600). Preceded by Sultanate and Malik. Their legacy influenced Portuguese conquer Malacca, disrupting existing trade networks and Sultan Babullah of Ternate expels the Portuguese from the Spice Islands.
